notes: Fixed the actual crash: the floating pen service was reading screen dimensions before the app was ready, which closed the app right after opening. The app now starts reliably.
The floating pen still appears, follows wherever you drag it, and stops cleanly when you close the app.
You can turn the floating pen on/off in Settings.
Android downloads use versioned file names, so you always get the newest APK.
The app fits every phone screen, with a back button and Android back-key navigation.
